name: Nishihara Kaho
source:
Likes: Shoujo manga (loves a lot), okonomiyaki, yakisoba, shopping, cooking
Dislikes: Drunk people, insects in general

[url=/c48319]Kazuya's[/url] childhood friend and classmate who is a member of the Intergender Relations Normalization Committee. Kaho has liked Kazuya for a long time but cannot tell him because she's a typical childhood friend tsundere girl who thinks he can't get anything done without her. Having good grades, good skills at all kinds of housework and attractive looks, she's popular with the other male students.
